entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining as the region's first such guidance
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Added Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the Guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA and not a regulated financial service」 The Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) has published its Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities in and from ADGM. Issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. The guidance applies a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms.

entry.title: ADGM regulator fines MCA Auditors and its audit principal USD 88,000 over audit failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s RA Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 88,000 Against MCA Auditors and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 23 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 23, 2026 · EnforcementThe ADGM Registration Authority imposed financial penalties totalling USD 88,000 on MCA Auditors and Advisors LLP and its Audit Principal for deficiencies in an audit. The action followed an on-site inspection of the firm's audit quality. Deficiencies included risk assessment, fraud risk, group audit requirements, governance communications, and insufficient evidence in material areas.

entry.title: Pantheon opens Abu Dhabi office and names regional head for Middle East
entry.summary: Pantheon expands Middle East presence with new Abu Dhabi office and senior regional appointment ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026Private markets firm Pantheon has opened its first office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi, and appointed Firas Mallah as Managing Director and Head of Middle East. The firm says the office will deepen its relationships with clients across GCC countries. The new office brings Pantheon's global footprint to 13 locations.

entry.title: FSRA Warns Public About Suspected Fraud by E-Community
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to Suspected Fraudulent Scheme by E-Community ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026 · EnforcementThe ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) warns the public about a suspected fraudulent scheme and false claims by E-Community, operating from e-community.co. The FSRA is concerned these claims could mislead investors into believing the entity is licensed to operate in ADGM. The FSRA advises checking its Public Register to verify any firm's Financial Services Permission before dealing with it.

entry.title: ADGM Registration Authority Publishes 2026-2027 Regulatory Priorities
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Publishes Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026 · GuidanceThe Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi's ADGM has published its Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027, setting out areas of monitoring, supervision and enforcement focus for the year ahead. The document lists ten priority areas, including filings, audit quality, consumer protection and AML/CFT compliance, along with key performance indicators. It aims to improve transparency and help stakeholders prepare for supervisory attention.

entry.title: Eurazeo opens Abu Dhabi office to expand its Middle East presence
entry.summary: Eurazeo Opens an Office in Abu Dhabi, Reinforcing Its Commitment To The Middle East ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026European private markets asset manager Eurazeo announces the opening of its first Middle East office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi's international financial centre. Led by Managing Director Adrien Pinelli, the office will act as a strategic hub for Gulf investors and portfolio companies. The announcement highlights growing investment links between the Gulf and Europe.

entry.title: ADGM regulator seeks feedback on proposed DeFi risk management guidance
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Invites Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 6, 2026 · Draft / consultation · CryptoTopic evidence: 「proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance (the Guidance) which sets out the FSRA’s expectations for how Authorised Persons and Recognised Bodies should identify, assess monitor and manage risks arising f」 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM has published a Consultation Paper on proposed guidance for managing risks from decentralised finance (DeFi). The guidance sets out expectations for how authorised persons and recognised bodies should identify, assess, monitor and manage risks from their DeFi engagements, covering governance, due diligence, financial crime controls and client asset safeguards. Comments are due by 30 November 2026 and may be sent to fsra.consultation@adgm.com.

entry.title: Capital Group Gains FSRA Licence in Abu Dhabi to Expand Middle East Presence
entry.summary: Capital Group secures FSRA licence in Abu Dhabi as it expands in the Middle East ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 · LicensingCapital Group, a major active investment manager, has received a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA of ADGM, allowing it to conduct trading, investment management and distribution activities in ADGM. The approval follows the firm's May 2026 announcement of its first Middle East office in Abu Dhabi, where it has relocated staff from North America, Europe and Asia.

entry.title: New Mountain Capital opens an Abu Dhabi office in ADGM to deepen Gulf client relationships
entry.summary: New Mountain Capital Opens Abu Dhabi Office in ADGM, Strengthening Long-Term Commitment to the Region ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 · LicensingNew Mountain Capital, a New York-based alternative investment firm, announced it has set up New Mountain Capital Middle East Limited in ADGM after receiving FSRA approval to conduct regulated activities. The office, led by Shehreyar Hameed as Senior Executive Officer, aims to deepen client relationships and grow its investor base in the GCC region.

entry.title: ADGM regulator seeks feedback on new strata property rules
entry.summary: ADGM Registration Authority Publishes Consultation Paper on Enhanced Strata Regulations 07 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe ADGM Registration Authority has issued a consultation on new Strata Regulations that would repeal and replace the Strata Title Regulations 2015. Key proposals include automatic creation of an Owners' Association when a strata plan is registered, appointment of a licensed Owners' Association Manager, and Registrar approval of annual budgets. The consultation closes on 22 October 2026.

entry.title: Numou and Comera Financial Holding partner to expand financing and payment options for UAE SMEs
entry.summary: Numou and Comera Financial Holding Partner to Expand Financing and Payment Solutions for UAE SMEs 07 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026Numou, an ADGM subsidiary, and Comera Financial Holding, part of Abu Dhabi's Royal Group, have signed a partnership agreement. CFH's financing, business account opening and digital payment products will be offered on Numou's digital marketplace. The collaboration aims to give UAE small and medium-sized enterprises more options for working capital, supply chain finance and payments.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about false and misleading claims by Takeo Investments
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to False and Misleading claims made by Takeo Investments 08 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 8, 2026 · EnforcementThe Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM warns the public that Takeo Investments, which previously operated a website, made false claims of association with ADGM. The website is no longer operational. The FSRA advises that only firms it has authorised may conduct Regulated Activities in ADGM, and investors should verify a firm's permission on the FSRA Public Register before dealing with it.

entry.title: ADGM FSRA Consults on Revisions to Fees and General Rulebooks
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Launches Consultation on Revisions to its Fees and General Rulebooks 09 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 9, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority published Consultation Paper No. 6 of 2026 proposing amendments to its Fees Rulebook and General Rulebook. The proposals update fees for Recognised Bodies and operators of Multilateral and Organised Trading Facilities, and introduce a supervision fee for Securities on the Official List. The paper also proposes a higher fee for late Regulatory Filings and clarifies fees for varying a Financial Services Permission. The consultation closes on 6 November 2026.

entry.title: ADGM regulator fines PKF Accountants and its audit principal USD 100,000 over audit failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 100,000 against PKF Accountants and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 09 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 9, 2026 · EnforcementThe Registration Authority (RA) of ADGM has imposed financial penalties totalling USD 100,000 on PKF Accountants and Business Advisers LLP and its registered audit principal, Ms Saranga Omprakash Lalwani, for audit failings. An on-site inspection found that an audit of an ADGM-registered entity was not conducted in accordance with International Standards on Auditing and lacked due skill, care and diligence. The findings included weak fraud risk assessment and inadequate audit evidence and documentation.

entry.title: 3iQ Unit Gets In-Principle Approval for ADGM Category 4 Licence
entry.summary: 3iQ Receives In-Principle Approval from Abu Dhabi’s IFC 12 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 12, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「3iQ Middle East Ltd, has secured In-Principle Approval (IPA) for a Category 4 license from the Financial Services Authority (FSRA) of ADGM」 3iQ Middle East Ltd, a UAE subsidiary of digital asset investment firm 3iQ, has received in-principle approval for a Category 4 licence from the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM). The announcement says the step is part of 3iQ's effort to be regulated and present in major digital asset hubs worldwide.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi delegation promotes investment opportunities in London
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi delegation to showcase Abu Dhabi’s investment opportunities in London 13 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 13, 2026Abu Dhabi Chamber, ADGM and Abu Dhabi Investment Office will lead a series of investment and business engagements in London during an Abu Dhabi delegation visit beginning 13 October 2026. The visit aims to showcase investment opportunities to international investors, strengthen private-sector ties and advance institutional partnerships. ADIO will host the third Abu Dhabi Investment Forum in London, and the Chamber will run its Global Executive Connect programme on 14 October.

entry.title: Pretium opens Abu Dhabi office to expand Middle East presence
entry.summary: Pretium Expands Middle East Presence with Abu Dhabi Office 14 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 14, 2026Pretium, an investment firm with about $70 billion in assets under management, has opened an office within Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM). The office aims to strengthen ties with regional institutional investors and expand investment opportunities through Pretium's residential real estate ecosystem. It will be led by Basim Habib and Dietrich Heidtmann.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi delegation's London visit advances investment partnerships and UK business opportunities
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi delegation concludes visit to London, Advancing Investment Partnerships and expanding business opportunities with UK companies 20 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 20, 2026 · ReportThe Abu Dhabi Investment Office, Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry and ADGM held a series of high-level engagements in London from 13 to 15 October, including the third Abu Dhabi Investment Forum. Discussions covered investment and business opportunities in financial services, advanced technology, healthcare, energy and trade. Abu Dhabi Customs also received the Border Innovation Award at the Chartered Institute of Export & International Trade's 2026 International Trade Awards for its blockchain-based TradeChain platform.

entry.title: Advent opens an Abu Dhabi office to extend its global footprint into the Middle East
entry.summary: Advent opens office in Abu Dhabi, further extending its international reach 21 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 21, 2026Advent, a global private equity investor, has opened a new office in ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi. The local base is intended to deepen engagement with investors, support existing portfolio companies, and explore potential investment opportunities. The office will be headed by Mehdi Iraqi.

entry.title: ADGM RA Consults on Enhanced Business Centre Regulatory Framework
entry.summary: ADGM RA Publishes Consultation Paper on Enhanced Business Centre Framework 15 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 15, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe ADGM Registration Authority has published a consultation paper seeking public feedback on proposed amendments to the Commercial Licensing Regulations, Controlled Activities Rules, Conditions of Licence and Branch Registration Rules, and Fees Rules. The amendments would make providing business centre services a controlled activity and set specific licence conditions for applicants and providers, aiming to protect business centre tenants and support continuity of their premises and registered office arrangements. The consultation closes on 6 November 2026.

entry.title: ADGM's Third Global Media Forum Presents Abu Dhabi's Growth to International Journalists
entry.summary: ADGM’s 3rd Global Media Forum Showcases Abu Dhabi’s Growth Story to International Media ADGM / FSRA · Oct 26, 2026ADGM held its third Global Media Forum, bringing 33 journalists, including 13 from overseas, to Abu Dhabi from 20 to 22 October 2026. The programme covered ADGM's regulatory and legal frameworks, a preview of Abu Dhabi Finance Week, economic panel discussions, and a visit to the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. The forum also marked ADGM's 11th anniversary."},
